card.name: Place words like nowhere and somewhere
card.fires_on: The word nowhere, or the where/place ending of somewhere, elsewhere, everywhere and nowhere. It fires when the word points to a location or an absence of one.

modes.label: Nowhere
modes.description: The word nowhere used to say something never occurs or is absent.
modes.example: …<< nowhere>> has anyone ever seen a body continue moving

modes.label: Where ending
modes.description: The where ending inside somewhere, elsewhere, or nowhere, often split into pieces.

modes.label: Place or everywhere
modes.description: Related place words such as place and everywhere that point to a location.
modes.example: << Everywhere>> heaps of bones were visible and every place

card.writes: It promotes somewhere and anywhere, which fits a location-indefinite word coming next.
card.plain: It spots words like nowhere, somewhere and elsewhere that say where something is or is not.
